CROSS-PLATFORM [Platform B] and [Platform A] show the same operating gap: spend is not governed tightly enough by economics. Five shared operational gaps and corrective fixes Cross-Platform Operational Gaps: [Platform B] vs [Platform A]
Gap [Platform B] [Platform A] Fix
Gap 1 - CPC above allowable level [Platform B] CPC ₹31.1 vs allowable ₹10.7 [Platform A] CPC ₹46.2 vs allowable ₹14.8 Break-even CPC bidding model
Gap 2 - Discovery leakage [Platform B] Auto, phrase, category, broad weak. [Platform A] Phrase, broad, generic weak. Weekly harvesting and negative loop
Gap 3 - Budget not following winners [Platform B] SBT and exact under-scaled. [Platform A] Brand and category/PLA under-allocated. Budget tiering by ROAS, CVR, and intent
Gap 4 - Visibility spend not separated [Platform B] SD/AMC weak. [Platform A] CPD/BOTD weak. Separate awareness and performance budgets
Gap 5 - Reporting and governance gaps [Platform B] Broken pivot ratios. [Platform A] Sheet reconciliation differences. Raw-data dashboard and source-of-truth reporting

90-DAY PLAN First stop leakage, then rebuild, then scale only where economics prove out. Concrete 30/60/90 actions to stabilize, rebuild, and scale Days 0–7 Days 0–7 (Stabilize)
  • Days 0–7 (Stabilize) — [Platform B]: Pause or negative 10+ click zero-sales terms. Reduce bids on ROAS <0.25x. Protect brand and exact winners. Cap SD, AMC, and weak category/competitor campaigns.
  • Days 0–7 (Stabilize) — [Platform A]: Cap CPD/BOTD unless awareness is objective. Reduce weak phrase/broad bids. Protect brand and exact winners. Identify low-ROAS city/SKU combinations.
 Days 8–30 Days 8–30 (Rebuild) Days 8–30 (Rebuild): Restructure by intent, SKU, city, and objective. Move converting terms into exact. Add negatives. Create budget tiers and build CPC ceilings. Days 31–90 Days 31–90 (Scale) Days 31–90 (Scale): Increase budgets on high-CVR/ROAS clusters. Test bundles for AOV. Run SBT/SBV/video tests on proven demand. Forecast budget by efficiency tier.

RECOMMENDATION The current account needs a sharper operator, not just more spend. Pitch to take over plus required data to move from diagnosis to execution The data shows that [Brand] has demand pockets that work, but the current operating model is allowing too much budget to flow into weak-intent, high-CPC traffic. Our agency would bring a structured, data-led marketplace growth system that connects media spend to SKU economics, city performance, search intent, and profitability. [Platform B] data needed
  • Search term
  • placement
  • advertised product reports
  • SQP data
 [Platform A] data needed
  • SKU-level campaign data
  • city-wise availability
  • organic sales
  • keyword-level order/revenue
 Business data needed
  • Target ACOS by SKU
  • Margin by SKU
  • Launch vs profitability priorities
 30-day transition audit and account takeover sprint. The audit findings above are the basis for a rapid takeover; deeper access will enable execution of break-even CPC bidding, city/SKU budget tiers, and weekly harvesting.
